svg.title: Six generated RPG map blockouts
svg.desc: Real SDK output using seed 1042. Solid footprints are brown, spawn is blue, portals are green, largest valid grid-center rectangle is outlined in magenta. These are data previews, not game artwork.

g.text: Seed: 1042 | Physical layout data, not AI artwork
Brown: solid footprint | Blue: spawn | Green: portal | Magenta: largest valid grid-center rectangle
